thread:
Elaine: Quick accessibility pass on the Console metrics panel — noticed low contrast on the legend labels and missing focus styles on the timeframe dropdown. Screenshot: https://redwood.app/s/figma/abc123
Matt: Thanks — can you repro steps? which browser and OS?
Elaine: Chrome on macOS, VoiceOver off for this quick visual check. Steps: open /console -> Metrics tab -> look at the small legend text next to the chart, then tab to the timeframe dropdown.
Sara: I saw that too in the dark theme. Legend text looks ~#6b6b6b on #0f1724 — contrast looks off.
Jon: Also keyboard nav: tabbing into the chart area skips the legend entirely. Focus order feels wrong.
a11y-bot: Automated scan results (1772560459): 3 failures detected: color-contrast (ratio 3.2:1), focus-visible (no visible focus for .dropdown-button), and aria-roles (toasts missing aria-live). See /audits/1772560459.
Matt: Can we get quick CSS patch for focus ring? something like an accessible outline on :focus?
Sara: Yes, minimal suggestion — use a high-contrast outline and avoid removing default focus styles. Example:```css
/* focus improvement for dropdowns/buttons */
.dropdown-button:focus {
  outline: 2px solid #0b5cff; /* blue with good contrast */
  outline-offset: 2px;
  box-shadow: none;
}
```
Elaine: Also for legend text we should bump to #e6eefc or similar for small labels to hit 4.5:1. Can we make legend text size 12 -> 13? tiny bump helps contrast.
Matt: Agree. For keyboard order, I can add tabindex handling so legend is reachable before the chart canvas. Jon, can you sketch the desired focus order?
Jon: Proposed order: header -> timeframe dropdown -> legend items (each focusable) -> chart canvas -> series controls. That lets screen reader users get context before the visual.
Elaine: For screen-reader friendliness, legend items should be buttons with `aria-pressed` state rather than plain spans. That way toggling series is announced.
Sara: And toasts need `role=\"status\"` or `aria-live=\"polite\"` so they announce without modal focus. a11y-bot flagged it.
Matt: I'll open a short-lived ticket for the fixes: RDW-7897 — focus styles, legend contrast/size, keyboard order, toasts ARIA. Assigning to @Matt. Expected patch: small CSS + semantics change, then a quick ChromeVox/VoiceOver pass.
Elaine: Can someone run the quick screen reader smoke test after changes? 5-10 mins.
Jon: I can run VoiceOver on macOS. Sara can run ChromeVox on Linux.
Matt: Plan: implement CSS + tabindex changes in a single PR, add unit for legend semantics, then merge behind feature flag. I’ll ping once it’s up.
Elaine: Also think about focus-visible only when using keyboard — use `:focus-visible` where supported. Keep outline for keyboard, not mouse.
Sara: Good call. For browsers without :focus-visible, we can keep polyfill or fallback.
Elaine: Ok — small follow-up: add note in the Console accessibility checklist about chart legend semantics and keyboard order.
Matt: Will do. Thanks y'all. :thumbsup:
a11y-bot: Reminder scheduled: run full screen reader audit next Wednesday at 16:00 UTC.
Elaine: Perfect — marking this as blocking until RDW-7897 lands.
Matt: On it, will update RDW ticket with audit links and patch diff.
Sara: Thanks — cheers.
